volumetric_physisorption.meaning_zh: 有限N2气体容量法、三独立分析位、实测曲线的显式数值迁移与六位双温区脱气
equations: nads_new=(1-a)nads_old+a*mtrue*q_equilibrium(Pnew),a=1-exp(-k*dt); exact piecewise-linear implicit solution at conserved Ntotal
q_equilibrium monotone projection of actual NISTN277K data, branch unspecified; origin bridge explicit; acquisition rejects targets outside measured pressure support
Finite source P=Nsource*R*Tamb/Vsource; N2valve dn limited by pressure gradient, finite source and pressure equalization; pump removes only available gas
q_report=(Nbaseline+Ndosed-Npumped-Pindicated*alpha_cal)/entered_mass; no direct reading of true material loading in returned measurement
Conditional pore volume=q(P/P0>=.95)*M_N2/rho_liquid77K; no extrapolated near-saturation points
BJH explicit desorption only: rk=-2gamma*Vliq/(RTlnx),t=.354nm*(5/-lnx)^(1/3),rp=rk+t; prior pore film correction and negative bins retained;2.5–500nm domain
Manifold/heater C*dT=Qinput-U*(T-Tambient)*dt; each reported energy ledger covers its defined thermal block only
Degas water removal=water*(1-exp(-k373*exp(-Ea/R*(1/T-1/373.15))*dt)); trapped finite water,2heater zones,6samples; kinetics and water latent thermal effect unvalidated

limitations: 厂家795×701×1079mm与136.4kg和调研表一致，质量随配置变化，部件质量未知。
1100Torr与官网括号0.997p/p0(N277K)不等价：单独保留绝对硬件上限146655.6079Pa与相对正常范围<0.997。
CryoSync官网表6100 N/A而应用资料称6100可选；采用标准共同77K液氮，CryoSync其他温度不实现。
6100仅物理吸附；6200/6300高温炉、TCD、化学吸附、MS不混入。
NIST原始分支/p0未标；ml/g不明参考状态3条排除；部分total_adsorption为空但唯一纯N2组分量有效，使用组分值并逐条记录。
真实局部尺寸、质量、摩擦、惯量、升降行程未知；几何按照片估计，数值部件分配总计136.4kg，惯量按包围盒。
真实等温线保留不改；运行层同压力均值、单调投影、低压原点Henry桥和STP273.15K/1atm换算单独标注。原始分支不明须宿主明确接受迁移。
气路死体积、动力学、泵速、热容/传热、传感器误差均显式宿主参数；理想气体和集总热模型不代表厂家精度。
BET有适用性检查；BJH只接显式脱附分支，不把当前分支未知数据伪称脱附。微孔DFT缺核不实现。
机器人/密封接触、CAD尺寸计量、真机通信、误差/故障分布未运行。
NIST branch labels and source p0 unknown；100可用材料是不同材料/配方，不是100种纯小分子。
标准环境外部压力101325Pa为显式边界假设；两温度He校准记录由宿主提供，自动He供气标定未实现。
脱气水分为有限宿主指定组分，Arrhenius系数未按真实材料拟合；六位脱气完成不等于厂家性能认证。
定义热账本仅含歧管/加热套和分析杜瓦冷负荷；冷阱独立液氮容积/热流未知，仅按冷源存在与有限水容量判定，不宣称完整热力学。
100distinctNISTmaterials measured literature curves; exact source instrument and original branch/p0 generally unknown; transfer is an engineering assumption.
Two-temperature He calibration consumes host-supplied experimental records; automatic He acquisition not implemented; only finiteN2 runtime gas.
Three independent method sequences at common standard77K; other gases/multitemperature/CryoSync/chemisorption/TCD/MS unsupported.
Current unknown-branch source curves do not generate a claimed BJH/DFT distribution; separate BJH analysis accepts explicitly identified desorption data.
0.35–2.5nm micropore DFT kernel and full500nm performance unavailable; empirical errors/precision/repeatability/probabilistic faults not calibrated.
Ideal77K bath and manifold+heater block energy only; gas/sample thermal transients, sorbate/volatile full enthalpy, cryogenic trapwater heat, pump and supply-bottle energy not solved.
Local geometries/travel/part masses/inertias unknown; robot/sealing/contact/hardware and filesystem truth isolation not_run.

coverage.note_zh: CHEM-115：标准Autosorb6100物理吸附配置，本体795×701×1079mm、136.4kg随配置；178几何部件、8关节、23端口、1电源灯、6预览；33能力中26实现、49状态槽、21单测。100不同NIST材料的真实N277K等温线及完整DOI/原始哈希，缺分支/p0标记；运行响应的同压力均值/单调投影/原点桥均显式工程假设。三分析位并行有限N2容量法、冷热自由空间独立标定、压力收支反演、条件BET、近饱和孔容和显式脱附BJH计算；未标分支曲线不伪造PSD，微孔DFT未实现。有限3L液氮、双温区六位脱气/有限水与冷阱、气体/固体/水/液氮和定义热块账本；升温残留气压力联锁和有限回填。实际双环境8关节、侧灯和过程锁步184检查通过，原生桥接通过；厂家分辨率不当作实测精度，真机/噪声/完整热力学/接触等not_run，整体partial。
